sources.title: Community bike co-op launches at Bishan park connector
MerMob's fleet numbers don't add up
Merlion Mobility Co-operative annual report FY2022
Riding every MerMob node in one weekend

claims.text: Merlion Mobility began as a volunteer bicycle-sharing scheme along the Bishan park connector in 2020.

citations.quote: a volunteer bicycle-sharing scheme along the Bishan park connector

claims.text: The co-operative claims a fleet of 480 bicycles.
An independent count found only around 310 usable bicycles.

citations.quote: our count across all 22 nodes found roughly 310 in usable condition

claims.text: MerMob operates docking nodes at 22 locations, mostly beside MRT stations and hawker centres.

citations.quote: 22 nodes, most of them a short walk from an MRT exit or a hawker centre

claims.text: Membership is priced at eight Singapore dollars a month with the first month free for students.

citations.quote: membership remained at S$8 per month, first month waived for full-time students

groups.question: How many bicycles are in the fleet?
